scope: Complete intrinsic Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA station: five folded longitudinal roof ribbons with glass strips, timber soffits and steel girders/inclined supports; eight elevated track lanes, mapped platform edges including shorter metro island and real stair/light openings; separated concrete viaduct decks and piers, open diagonal concourse with intrinsic stair/escalator banks, framed platform-end glazing and low auxiliary enclosures. Exclude adjacent AFAS Live, arena, offices/shops outside the station, bus fleet, trains, people, signs/logos, public plaza and natural ground. Roof section/canopy registration, pier census and concealed details are explicit estimates; native platform/hall coordinates remain unchanged.
